A small dragon circles the tower's glowing peak, silhouetted against the violet evening sky.
A spell goes dramatically wrong, erupting in crackling light that sends sparks and scrolls flying.
A beam of brilliant arcane light lances upward from the tower's crown into swirling storm-clouds.
A magical storm coils around the spire, throwing off arcs of lightning and ghostly color.
A shimmering portal tears open in mid-air beside the tower, glowing with unstable azure fire.
A flight of luminous winged creatures sweeps past the tower in a breathtaking cascading formation.
A floating island drifts slowly past the tower's window, trailing waterfalls and trailing green vines.
An aurora blazes overhead, wrapping the tower in curtains of shifting green and violet light.
A great full moon rises directly behind the tower, framing its silhouette in pale silver.
A summoned fire elemental looms over the tower's battlements, roaring with towering pillars of flame.
Books and glowing objects swirl in a wild magical vortex centered on the tower's study.
A second smaller dragon perches on the tower's ledge, breathing soft plumes of golden smoke.
A cascade of multicolored magical sparks rains down from the tower's highest window in sheets.
An enormous spectral hand reaches from a rift in the clouds, grasping toward the spire.
A river of luminous spell-text streams upward along the tower's outer walls like living script.
A pair of phoenixes spiral upward past the tower, trailing long ribbons of blazing feathers.
A chunk of floating rock, carrying ancient ruins, slowly rotates past the tower's upper floors.
A swarm of tiny enchanted lights bursts from the tower's door like a firefly explosion.
A robed figure tumbles from a high window, caught mid-fall by a swirling levitation spell.
Enormous translucent runes flare into existence around the tower, rotating slowly in a glowing constellation.
A thundercloud shaped like a vast dragon's head hovers directly above the tower's pointed peak.
A mirror-calm magic circle blazes to life at the tower's base, summoning a swirling gateway.
Waves of shimmering heat and color ripple outward from the tower as a great spell detonates.
A colossal summoned water elemental crests above the tower, its watery form catching the moonlight.
